sources.title: OCI Architecture Center
sources.fallback_text: OCI Architecture Center provides reference architectures and solution patterns for designing workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Use it to compare service choices, understand common deployment topologies, and identify design considerations for availability, networking, security, and operations.

sources.title: OCI Well-Architected Framework
sources.fallback_text: OCI Well-Architected Framework organizes architecture review around reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization. Architecture recommendations should call out assumptions, risks, and tradeoffs across these pillars.

sources.title: OCI Virtual Cloud Network Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Virtual Cloud Networks provide isolated, configurable networks for cloud resources. VCN design should define CIDR ranges, subnets, route tables, security lists or network security groups, gateways, and private connectivity patterns.

sources.title: OCI Load Balancer Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Load Balancer distributes traffic to backend resources and supports highly available application entry points. Designs should consider public versus private load balancers, backend health checks, listener configuration, TLS termination, and fault-domain placement.

sources.title: OCI Object Storage Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Object Storage stores durable unstructured data such as static website assets, product media, logs, backups, and artifacts. Architecture recommendations should consider buckets, lifecycle policies, retention, access controls, encryption, replication needs, and cost tradeoffs for static and archival content.

sources.title: OCI CDN Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI CDN and edge services help deliver static content closer to users and can reduce origin load for web and ecommerce workloads. Designs should evaluate cacheable assets, TLS, origin protection, traffic routing, performance goals, availability requirements, and security controls such as WAF where appropriate.

sources.title: OCI Compute Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Compute provides virtual machines, bare metal instances, images, shapes, and autoscaling options for application workloads. Architecture reviews should connect compute choices to availability, scaling, performance, patching, and operational requirements.

sources.title: OCI Database Services Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI database services include managed Oracle Database options and supporting capabilities for resilient data tiers. Architecture recommendations should clarify data durability, backup, recovery, high availability, Data Guard-style protection where appropriate, connectivity, and operational ownership.

sources.title: OCI Kubernetes Engine Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Kubernetes Engine, also known as OKE, runs managed Kubernetes clusters on OCI. Migration from EKS should assess Kubernetes versions, ingress controllers, worker node pools, persistent volumes, container registry, IAM mappings, secrets, networking, observability, and rollout strategy.

sources.title: OCI Database Migration Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Database Migration supports database migration planning and execution. Migration from RDS to OCI should discover the source engine, version, extensions, data size, downtime tolerance, replication needs, validation approach, and target service such as Base Database Service, Autonomous Database, MySQL HeatWave, or another managed database option.

sources.title: OCI Full Stack Disaster Recovery Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI disaster recovery design should define RTO and RPO targets, application criticality tiers, cross-region topology, database replication, Data Guard-style database protection where appropriate, backups, DNS or traffic failover, runbooks, monitoring, security controls, and regular DR drills. Fintech DR designs also need auditability, key management, and evidence of tested recovery.

sources.title: OCI Cost Management Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI cost optimization should use budgets, cost analysis, tagging, right-sized compute, autoscaling, storage tiering, lifecycle policies, environment shutdown schedules, and measured utilization. Cost reviews should preserve required availability, backup, security, and monitoring controls.

sources.title: OCI Security Services Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI security architecture should cover IAM, least privilege, compartment strategy, network security groups, private subnets, encryption, Vault for keys and secrets, Cloud Guard, Security Zones, logging, audit, monitoring, and compliance evidence.

sources.title: OCI Identity and Access Management Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Identity and Access Management provides identity domains, users, groups, dynamic groups, policies, federation, and authentication controls. Architecture guidance should define compartment strategy, least privilege policies, workload identities, administrator access, break-glass access, and audit expectations.

sources.title: OCI Network Security Groups Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Network Security Groups provide virtual firewall rules for selected VNICs. Designs should use NSGs to express application-tier and data-tier traffic policy, reduce broad subnet-level exposure, and support auditable east-west and ingress controls.

sources.title: OCI Autonomous Database Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Autonomous Database is a managed Oracle Database service with automated operations. Architecture and migration guidance should evaluate workload type, connectivity, private endpoints, backup and recovery needs, performance, data movement, compatibility, and operational ownership.

sources.title: OCI Vault Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Vault provides key management and secrets capabilities. Enterprise designs should use Vault for customer-managed keys, secret storage, rotation planning, encryption governance, backup and DR access, and separation of duties for sensitive application configuration.

sources.title: OCI Logging Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Logging collects and manages service, custom, and audit-related logs. Architecture recommendations should include centralized logging, retention, log groups, operational troubleshooting, security investigation, and integration with monitoring or downstream analysis.

sources.title: OCI Monitoring Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Monitoring provides metrics, alarms, and notifications for cloud resources and applications. Designs should define health signals, alarms, notification topics, SLO indicators, capacity trends, cost signals, and incident response expectations.

sources.title: OCI Cloud Guard Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Cloud Guard helps detect and respond to security posture problems. Security architecture guidance should consider detector recipes, responder recipes, monitored compartments, posture findings, operations ownership, and integration with incident response.

sources.title: OCI Web Application Firewall Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Web Application Firewall protects web applications at the edge. Internet-facing architectures should evaluate WAF policies, origin protection, TLS, bot and threat controls, CDN integration, logging, and operational tuning for application security.

sources.title: OCI DNS Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI DNS manages public and private DNS zones and records for workloads on OCI. Architecture guidance should cover DNS cutover, TTL planning, split-horizon private resolution, traffic steering assumptions, failover runbooks, and migration mapping from Route 53 or other DNS providers.

sources.title: OCI FastConnect Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI FastConnect provides private dedicated connectivity between customer networks and OCI. Hybrid migration and enterprise architecture guidance should evaluate bandwidth, redundancy, routing, DR connectivity, encryption requirements, latency, and fallback VPN or internet paths.

sources.title: OCI API Gateway Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI API Gateway provides managed API front doors for HTTP services and functions. Designs should evaluate public versus private APIs, authentication and authorization, throttling, deployment stages, logging, WAF or load balancer placement, and migration from API gateway patterns in other clouds.

sources.title: OCI Functions Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Functions supports event-driven serverless workloads. Architecture guidance should keep persistent state in managed data services, evaluate cold start and concurrency expectations, use IAM policies and network controls, and map AWS Lambda-style functions only after trigger, dependency, packaging, and observability review.

sources.title: OCI Container Registry Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Container Registry stores container images for OKE and containerized workloads. Kubernetes modernization should include image migration from ECR or other registries, repository strategy, vulnerability and access controls, deployment promotion, rollback, and integration with CI/CD.

sources.title: OCI Block Volume Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Block Volume provides persistent block storage for compute workloads. Architecture guidance should evaluate performance tiers, attachment model, backups, cloning, encryption, availability placement, cost, and whether state should remain on block storage or move into managed database and object storage services.

sources.title: OCI File Storage Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI File Storage provides shared file systems for applications that need NFS-style access. Designs should validate mount targets, subnet placement, security rules, throughput, backup strategy, application consistency, and migration from shared file storage patterns.

sources.title: OCI MySQL HeatWave Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI MySQL HeatWave is a managed MySQL-compatible database service with analytics acceleration. Migration guidance from RDS MySQL should validate engine compatibility, extensions, connectivity, backup and recovery, high availability, performance, cutover, rollback, and cost-performance tradeoffs.

sources.title: OCI GoldenGate Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI GoldenGate supports real-time data replication and data movement patterns. Architecture guidance should evaluate source and target compatibility, replication topology, latency, conflict handling, validation, cutover, rollback, DR replication, and operational monitoring.

sources.title: OCI Data Integration Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Data Integration supports ETL and data pipeline design. Analytics architectures should define ingestion sources, scheduling, transformations, replay, schema evolution, failure isolation, observability, governance, and migration mapping from Glue-style data engineering workflows.

sources.title: OCI Streaming Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Streaming provides durable streaming ingestion for event and data pipelines. Designs should evaluate partitions, throughput, retention, consumer lag, replay, error handling, monitoring, pipeline scaling, and migration mapping from Kinesis-style streaming workloads.

sources.title: OCI Data Science Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Data Science supports machine learning workflows and model deployment patterns. AI inference architecture should evaluate model artifact lifecycle, private endpoints or controlled ingress, data access, IAM, Vault, logging, monitoring, rollout and rollback, latency SLOs, GPU or compute sizing, and cost controls.

sources.title: OCI Notifications Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Notifications delivers messages from alarms and event-driven workflows. Operational architecture should define notification topics, subscriptions, escalation paths, incident ownership, DR exercise alerts, and integration with Monitoring alarms and runbooks.

sources.title: OCI Audit Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Audit records API activity for OCI resources. Security and regulated workload guidance should include audit retention, access controls, investigation workflows, compliance evidence, integration with Logging, and validation during DR exercises and migration cutovers.

sources.title: OCI Events Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Events reacts to resource state changes and service events. Architecture guidance should evaluate event rules, targets, audit and operational workflows, automated notifications, integration with Functions, and guardrails for resource lifecycle visibility.

sources.title: OCI Service Connector Hub Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Service Connector Hub moves data such as logs between OCI services. Observability and analytics designs should consider log routing, filtering, delivery targets, retention, access controls, downstream analysis, cost, and failure handling.

sources.title: OCI Data Safe Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Data Safe helps assess and monitor database security posture. Regulated database architectures should evaluate sensitive data discovery, user assessment, activity auditing, masking considerations, compliance reporting, and integration with IAM, Vault, Logging, and Monitoring.

sources.title: OCI Resource Manager Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Resource Manager manages Terraform-based infrastructure as code. Enterprise delivery guidance should include versioned stacks, plan review, policy controls, drift detection, environment promotion, rollback, and separation between infrastructure changes and application deployments.

sources.title: OCI DevOps Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI DevOps supports build and deployment pipelines for OCI workloads. Architecture guidance should evaluate deployment stages, approvals, artifact promotion, rollback, environment separation, OKE or Compute targets, notifications, and observability for release health.

sources.title: OCI Bastion Overview
sources.fallback_text: OCI Bastion provides controlled access to private resources without exposing public management ports. Secure architecture guidance should evaluate session scope, IAM policy, private subnet access, auditability, break-glass procedures, and operational alternatives.

sources.title: OCI Reference Architecture: Highly Available Web Application
sources.fallback_text: A highly available OCI web application separates public ingress, private application subnets, and private data tiers. Reference architecture guidance should combine Load Balancer or API Gateway, WAF for internet-facing paths, Compute or OKE for scalable application capacity, Object Storage and CDN for static assets, managed databases for durable state, Logging and Monitoring for operations, IAM and compartments for boundaries, and backup or DR plans based on RTO/RPO.

sources.title: OCI Reference Architecture: Multi-Region SaaS Platform
sources.fallback_text: A multi-region SaaS platform on OCI should define tenant isolation, shared service boundaries, data residency, traffic failover, control-plane and data-plane separation, cost allocation tags, tenant-level observability, and DR runbooks. Service choices should align Load Balancer, OKE or Compute, Database Services or Autonomous Database, Object Storage, Vault, IAM, Logging, Monitoring, and Cost Management with the selected isolation and region strategy.

sources.title: OCI Reference Architecture: AI Inference Platform
sources.fallback_text: An OCI AI inference platform should control model artifacts in Object Storage, expose private APIs unless public access is required, use Compute, GPUs, or OKE based on measured throughput and latency, protect secrets with Vault and IAM, monitor latency, saturation, error rate, rollout health, and cost, and use staged deployments with rollback for model versions.
